therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: insulin sensitization and neuroprotection via metabolic modulation
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Number of participants with any adverse events and severity of AEs up to Week 82

results.effect_size: 125/331 participants experienced any AE; 46 had drug-related AEs of special interest
results.target_engagement_evidence: HbA1c change from baseline minimal (range -0.02 to +0.09%) suggesting limited glycemic effect in this non-diabetic population
biomarker_changes: HbA1c change from baseline ranged from -0.02% to +0.09% across timepoints
Total cholesterol increased from baseline (up to +1.163 mmol/L at Year 2 W24)
LDL increased from baseline (up to +1.051 mmol/L at Year 2 W24)
HDL decreased from baseline (up to -0.150 mmol/L at Year 2 W24)
Body weight increased modestly (up to +0.6 kg mean change at W24)
ADAS-Cog worsened from baseline: +1.9 at W24, +2.5 at W52 (all subjects)
MMSE declined from baseline: -0.7 at W24, -1.6 at W52 (all subjects)
DAD declined from baseline: -3.2 at W24, -5.2 at W52 (all subjects)
NPI worsened from baseline: +1.1 at W24, +2.1 at W52 (all subjects)
CIBIC+ mean score 4.3 at W24 and 4.5 at W52 (indicating minimal worsening)
subgroup_findings: APOE4-negative subjects showed greater ADAS-Cog worsening at W52 (+3.0) vs APOE4-positive (+1.8)
APOE4-positive subjects showed greater MMSE decline at W52 (-2.1) vs APOE4-negative (-1.2)
APOE4-positive subjects showed greater DAD decline at W52 (-3.8) vs APOE4-negative (-6.2)
APOE4-positive subjects showed greater NPI worsening at W52 (+2.8) vs APOE4-negative (+1.5)
safety_signals: 125/331 participants experienced any AE
46 participants had drug-related AEs of special interest
8 serious adverse events reported
3 deaths reported
13% of participants experienced edema
Modest increases in total cholesterol and LDL observed
Modest decreases in HDL observed
Small mean body weight increases observed
GGT elevations of potential clinical concern in 308 participants during treatment
High LDL of potential clinical concern in 135 participants during treatment
High cholesterol of potential clinical concern in 52 participants during treatment
High creatine kinase in 32 participants during treatment
Red cell distribution width high in 30 participants during treatment
Hemoglobin low in 20 participants during treatment
High glucose in 19 participants during treatment
High urea in 19 participants during treatment
High BUN/creatinine ratio in 18 participants during treatment
Monocytes low in 17 participants during treatment
Segmented neutrophils low in 14 participants during treatment
Total neutrophils low in 14 participants during treatment
WBC low in 9 participants during treatment
Trial terminated based on preliminary parent study results

context.investigator_commentary: Trial was terminated based on preliminary parent study results.
